Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HOOK, DECAPITATION, J ARDINE'S PATTERN 



(Reaffirmed 1997) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for decapitation hook, Jardine's pattern. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in FiQ. 1.

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 40Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 * Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4r Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 AM the surfaces oi the hook shall be smooth and free from pits, dents, burrs, scales and other 
defects. 

4.2 The cutting edge shall be sharp and free from nicks and feathers. 

4.3 The hook shall be well balanced.

4.4 All edges except the cutting edge shall be rounded. 

4.5 The tip of the hook shall be bulbous. 

4.6 The hook shall be pasaivated and polished bright. 

S. Heat Treatment — The hook shall be hardened and tempered to 500 to 550 H/ measured as 
near to the working end as possible. 

•• Corrosfon Restsiance 7'es/™Te9t the hook in accordance with 18:7531-1975 'Method for 
Doiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'* The 
hook shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

7, Marking — The hook shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, Initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' stainless steel '. 

7.1 fSi Certification Marking — Details avaffable with the Indian Standards (nstitution. 

8. Packing — The hooks shall be wrapped In moistureproof paper or packed in polyethylene bags, 
avoiding contact with one another.
